response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and polyglot development experience with a focus on testability and modern tooling, but his background lacks depth in C++ for industrial automation, secure development lifecycle (SDL), and cloud-native industrial systems. His open-source contributions and leadership in developer tooling are notable, but the role requires specialized expertise in C++, multi-threading, and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443).
strengths: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Proven leadership in mentoring, technical documentation, and cross-functional collaboration (e.g., workshops, talks, and team tooling).
Diverse technical stack exposure, including low-latency systems (DLang), REST/MQTT (GISCollective), and cloud platforms (AWS CDK).
concerns: Limited recent hands-on C++ experience; primary expertise lies in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang.
No explicit mention of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) in resume.
Lacks direct experience in industrial automation protocols (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA) or high-performance multi-threaded C++ systems.
